BiblicalUsage: Ahban is named once: 'she bare him Ahban, and Molid' — a son of Abishur in the genealogy of Judah, with no story, no deed, and no word spoken.
TheologicalSignificance: There is no doctrine in this name, and I will not manufacture one. He is remembered because the Chronicler remembered the families of Judah, and Judah's families mattered because the Messiah would come from them.
